info.title: MedLedger API
info.description: End-to-end encrypted vault, sharing, and grant API.

post.description: Issue a Proof-of-Work challenge. Client must solve before registering.
Verify a PoW solution. Returns success or 400 on invalid solution.
Register a new user. Sends a verification code to the provided email.
Verify the email address with the 6-digit code sent during registration.
Resend the email verification code.

Authenticate with email + password.
Returns tokens on success, or requires_totp=True if TOTP is enabled.
Complete login with TOTP second factor.
Rotate a refresh token — returns a new access + refresh token pair.
Logout from the current device.
Logout from all devices by revoking all tokens.
Change password — requires current password. Revokes all sessions.
Send a password reset code to an email address.
Verify reset code and set a new password.

Begin TOTP setup. Returns provisioning URI + backup codes.
Backup codes are shown ONCE — store them safely.
Confirm TOTP setup with a live 6-digit code from the authenticator app.
Disable TOTP — requires password + current TOTP code.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile.
Return own public keys. No audit event — not a sensitive lookup.
Get both public keys for another user. Logged as a key access event.
Get the X25519 exchange key for a user (to encrypt data for them).
Get the Ed25519 signing key for a user (to verify their signatures).

put.description: Update own signing and/or exchange public keys.

post.description: Request an encrypted record from its owner.

Owner sends encrypted payload to recipient.
Payload is never stored — returned directly in this response.
Owner rejects a pending share request.

get.description: Get pending share requests addressed to the authenticated user.
Poll for pending payload-ready notifications.
